textRuns.value: HOW THESE GET USED - BOARD packs carry the policy ratios (program %, reserves, concentration, public support) as 3-year trends against board-set targets, with variances explained, never bare numbers. The CEO watches the operating set weekly/monthly (cash days, current ratio, personnel %). FUNDERS read program %, reserves, revenue diversification and your latest audit - be ready with three years of 990s and context for any ratio outside its band.
